0022600163.text: The 76ers host the Bulls at 6-1, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, on a three-game winning streak and a 3-1 home record. Chicago is 1-5 and on a four-game losing streak, sitting 13th in the East and 4 games back in the Central. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the 76ers lost their 2025-26 series 1-2 and won the most recent meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring).
